messages:
maria (AE): Orion asked for a hosted API key for a 10-day POC. Requirements: generation only, IP lock to two addresses, portal one-time reveal, and automated rotation mid-POC. Can we provision by tomorrow AM?

igor (SE): Got it. Need exact IPs and expected QPS (so we can set rate limits). Also confirm region (eu-west or eu-central).

maria (AE): IPs: 52.18.9.10/32, 52.18.9.11/32. Low traffic: 3 qps. Region: eu-west.

nisha (Security): Security rules: IP allowlist mandatory (no wildcards), TTL <=14 days, audit_log enabled and exported to security channel, rate limit <=10 qps. If any regulated data is expected, escalate.

pete (DevEx): I will create a short-lived key with expires_at=POC end, enable audit_log:true, set rate_limit_qps=8, and schedule a rotation job at day 5 to create a replacement and revoke old. I won't post secrets here.

igor (SE): For rotation, recommend a 10-minute overlap window where both keys are valid while customer switches to the new secret via portal reveal. That reduces breakage.

pete (DevEx): Agreed. Flow I'll run: POST /v1/admin/keys with label `orion-poc-186000`, allowed_ips, scopes [generate.text], audit_log, expires_at. Then create rotation ticket: create new key on day 5, portal reveal to customer, wait 10m, DELETE old key.

nisha (Security): Approved provided audit logs are forwarded and the key has minimal scopes. Please add metadata: contact:procurement@orion.example.com and purpose:poc.

maria (AE): I'll confirm procurement contact and that they won't send PII.

pete (DevEx): Creating now. I will post the key_id (no secret) and trigger portal reveal.

secret-bot: key_provisioned: {"key_id":"key-orion-zz12","label":"orion-poc-186000","expires_at":"2026-09-01T12:00:00Z","allowed_ips":["52.18.9.10/32","52.18.9.11/32"]} (secret withheld)

maria (AE): Thanks all 013 I'll send onboarding + portal link to Orion and close thread after rotation completes.
